extension.summary: Functional: a clean, opinionated Kodi skin
extension.description: Functional. Built for clarity: gallery library views, configurable accent colour, slide-out filters, side-by-side library stats on home, and a tight video OSD.
extension.news: New: the Coming up list counts down to the slot that plays next. While Engage's countdown switch is on (Engage 1.11.11 or later) and the next slot is within its window, its line shows the minutes left and a thin bar that empties as it nears. New: the skip pill can be set per show: the default, Intros and Recaps, With Credits, or No Pill. The info screen's per show button reads This Show while the pill is on and asks which choice to change. A show set to No Pill asks the server nothing. The Playback page's switch still turns the pill off for every show, and it stays off by default.

extension.summary: Install and update the Functional skin
extension.description: Points Kodi at the Functional skin releases on GitHub. Install this once and Kodi keeps the skin up to date on its own.
